topic: GTA 6: Paul Walker tribute, Brian O'Conner's green 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse in a Vespucci Island garage (Toyo vs Terada decals), and the Toy Story 'snake in my boot' trunk gag
title: What's locked inside this GTA 6 garage? #shorts
lines: What's hiding behind one locked garage door in GTA 6?
Break into a villa on Vespucci Island and you'll find a bright green 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse.
It's Brian O'Conner's car from the first Fast and the Furious, a quiet tribute to Paul Walker.
In the 2001 film, it got shot up in a drive-by. Here, you hotwire it and drive away.
Rockstar even swapped its Toyo decals for a made-up brand, Terada.
But the real surprise is in the trunk.
Pop it open, and a snake attacks. It's Woody's line from Toy Story: there's a snake in my boot.
So next time you pass Vespucci Island, ask yourself:
description: GTA 6 hides a Fast and Furious legend in a locked Vice City garage, and its trunk has a second secret. #gta6 #gtavi #fastandfurious #easteregg #shorts
